one_sentence_story: Inspired by a Berlin cafe waiter who forgot orders the instant the bill was paid, Bluma Zeigarnik's 1927 experiments showed unfinished tasks stay ~90% more accessible in awareness than completed ones because an active goal maintains mental tension until closed — or until parked in a concrete written plan.
so_what_for_you: At the end of every workday, spend two minutes writing down the exact time and place you will tackle each unfinished task tomorrow ('Shutdown Ritual') so your brain closes its open tabs and lets you rest.
